item.title: California governor candidate Tom Steyer receives major union endorsement
item.description: Tom Steyer, a Democratic gubernatorial candidate in California, received an endorsement from the United Domestic Workers (UDW) Executive Board, representing over 250,000 workers in the state.

item.title: NASA SpaceX Crew-11 astronaut treated at San Diego hospital gives update
item.description: NASA has provided an update from the astronaut whose medical condition prompted an evacuation from the International Space Station (ISS) and splashdown off the coast of San Diego in January.

item.title: Child crashes e-bike into parked car as Carlsbad ordinance takes effect
item.description: A child riding an e-bike crashed into a parked car in Carlsbad, right as the city implements stricter e-bike regulations to improve safety.

item.title: San Marcos Unified proposes staff cuts, keeps librarians amid community pressure
item.description: The San Marcos Unified School District is proposing staff cuts for the next school year due to an $11 million budget deficit, but librarians have been spared from receiving preliminary layoff notices.

item.title: Serious injury reported in downtown moped crash
item.description: A 60-year-old woman was seriously injured while riding a moped in downtown Thursday night.

item.title: Police investigate possibly injured woman in canyon
item.description: Police are investigating a report of suspicious activity in the Serra Mesa community after a resident reported that a local mail carrier, who was not in uniform, asked to enter their property and was later found in a nearby canyon.

item.title: 9 Navy sailors arrested in connection to violent Jamul assault
item.description: Ten suspects, including nine Navy sailors, have been arrested in connection with an assault that happened at a house party in Jamul last year.

item.title: Navy veteran awarded Medal of Honor returns to San Diego County home
item.description: U.S. Navy veteran Royce Williams, a Korean War pilot, was awarded the Congressional Medal of Honor by President Trump during his State of the Union address.

item.title: Power outage affects Mission Valley, Kearny Mesa and Tierra Santa
item.description: Hundreds of people in San Diego County were left without power Thursday night due to an unknown cause, and SDG&E estimates power will be restored by Friday at 2 a.m.

item.title: Suspect arrested for alleged theft, stabbing at Fashion Valley mall
item.description: A suspect was arrested for allegedly trying to steal from the JCPenney department store in Fashion Valley, and police said in the process, bit and stabbed security guards.
